note: A window of actual Mars Global Surveyor MOLA elevations with spherical Mars curvature and 1× vertical relief. Colors encode elevation above the areoid and are not a surface photograph. The rectangular crop is context, not the feature boundary; coordinates are never stretched to the catalog length. The map uses a spherical reference areoid and does not reproduce the full Mars gravity field. The catalog value is the approximate canyon-system length, not a traced centerline or the crop width.

operations: Read exact retained MOLA sample centers and int16 heights
Map into a spherical local east/up/south frame
Keep true relief; color by elevation
Triangulate retained samples; compute geometric normals
